basic container with markdown body
.
:::note
hello *world*
:::
.
<div class="markdown-it-directive markdown-it-directive-note">
<p>hello <em>world</em></p>
</div>
.


title is rendered as escaped plain text
.
:::warning <img src=x>
body
:::
.
<div class="markdown-it-directive markdown-it-directive-warning">
<p class="markdown-it-directive-title">&lt;img src=x&gt;</p>
<p>body</p>
</div>
.


nested containers keep hierarchy
.
:::note outer
:::warning <img>
inner
:::
:::
.
<div class="markdown-it-directive markdown-it-directive-note">
<p class="markdown-it-directive-title">outer</p>
<div class="markdown-it-directive markdown-it-directive-warning">
<p class="markdown-it-directive-title">&lt;img&gt;</p>
<p>inner</p>
</div>
</div>
.


close marker inside fenced code is just code content
.
:::note
```
:::
```
:::
after
.
<div class="markdown-it-directive markdown-it-directive-note">
<pre><code>:::
</code></pre>
</div>
<p>after</p>
.


unclosed container falls back to plain text and keeps following blocks
.
:::note
unclosed

para after
.
<p>:::note
unclosed</p>
<p>para after</p>
.


container inside list item
.
- :::note
  item text
  :::
.
<ul>
<li>
<div class="markdown-it-directive markdown-it-directive-note">
<p>item text</p>
</div>
</li>
</ul>
.


container inside blockquote
.
> :::warning
> quoted
> :::
.
<blockquote>
<div class="markdown-it-directive markdown-it-directive-warning">
<p>quoted</p>
</div>
</blockquote>
.


name must start with a letter
.
:::1bad
:::
.
<p>:::1bad
:::</p>
.


four colons is not a directive
.
::::
:::
.
<p>::::
:::</p>
.


name allows digits, underscores and dashes
.
:::my-note_2
body
:::
.
<div class="markdown-it-directive markdown-it-directive-my-note_2">
<p>body</p>
</div>
.


multiple blocks inside container
.
:::note
first

second
:::
.
<div class="markdown-it-directive markdown-it-directive-note">
<p>first</p>
<p>second</p>
</div>
.
